## Setup

```{r fig1-setup, code=code_for("../script/Figure1.R", c("^", "Load data")), eval=FALSE}
```

## (B) Cells by organ and by disease category {#fig1b}

```{r fig1b-code, code=code_for("../script/Figure1.R", "1b"), eval=FALSE}
```

```{r fig1b-img, echo=FALSE, out.width="49%"}
knitr::include_graphics(c("assets/Figure1/1b_cellcount_organ.png",
                          "assets/Figure1/1b_cellcount_conditionbroad.png"))
```

::: {.figcaption}
**Fig. 1B.** Summary of sampled conditions organised by tissue and broad
disease category. Bar plots indicate the total number of T cells sequenced per
organ (left; the figure places these above the condition table) and per disease
category (right; placed to the left of the table). The table of specific
disease models that sits between them in the published figure is typeset for
the manuscript and is not plotted. Co-infection experiments are counted under
*virus*.
:::

## (D) IGT5 transcriptome UMAP {#fig1d}

```{r fig1d-code, code=code_for("../script/Figure1.R", "1d-1f"), eval=FALSE}
```

```{r fig1d-img, echo=FALSE, out.width="45%"}
knitr::include_graphics("assets/Figure1/1d_IGT5_UMAP_RNA_clusters.png")
```

::: {.figcaption}
**Fig. 1D.** UMAP visualization of the representative dataset IGT5 (skin, ear
and back, baseline) based on gene expression, with cells coloured by that
experiment's own transcriptomic clusters.
:::

## (E) IGT5 surface-protein UMAP {#fig1e}

```{r fig1e-img, echo=FALSE, out.width="45%"}
knitr::include_graphics("assets/Figure1/1e_IGT5_UMAP_ADT_RNAclusters.png")
```

::: {.figcaption}
**Fig. 1E.** UMAP of the same cells based on surface protein expression
(CITE-seq), coloured by the gene-expression clusters shown in (D). Clusters
defined on RNA remain largely separable in protein space.
:::

## (F) Flow-cytometry-like protein plots {#fig1f}

```{r fig1f-code, code=code_for("../script/Figure1.R", "doc:1f"), eval=FALSE}
```

```{r fig1f-img, echo=FALSE, out.width="45%"}
knitr::include_graphics(c("assets/Figure1/1f_IGT5_TCRB_TCRGD.png",
                          "assets/Figure1/1f_IGT5_CD4_CD8B.png"))
```

::: {.figcaption}
**Fig. 1F.** Flow-cytometry-like expression of TCRγδ versus TCRβ and CD4 versus
CD8β in IGT5 (CITE-seq, log1p(CP10K)), coloured by point density.
:::
